ideas.title: Investigating Autism Program Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the handling of kickback complaints in the Minnesota autism program and explore the need for increased oversight and accountability.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential corruption
questions: What is the extent of the problem?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a pattern of neglect and corruption in the Minnesota autism program. By following the money and investigating potential corruption, we can hold those responsible accountable and ensure that the program is serving its intended purpose.
